prompt: Create ONE separate book illustration of John, the real man in the photographic references, for The Vegetable Guru. Preserve his recognisable likeness: receding hairline with wispy short grey-brown hair at the sides, high forehead, short salt-and-pepper beard and moustache, gentle eyes, friendly understated smile, ordinary proportions. Faithful middle-aged-to-older adult face, not a caricature or generic garden mascot. Clothing follows the source: open muted red/cream/navy checked shirt, plain olive T-shirt, olive shorts; omit recording microphone and logos. Translate people, clothes, tools and plants into one coherent polished, dimensional vector-like drawn style governed by the approved vegetable hero references: bold simplified silhouettes, broad overlapping colour and shadow planes, natural skin colours, rich lime/forest foliage with sparse cream tapered highlights. No black contour outlines, no stippling, no etched/pencil texture, no watercolour, no photographic texture, no glossy plastic skin. Simplify shirt checks to broad clean lines. Keep hands anatomically plausible and natural, with readable finger grips. Show only a small garden/greenhouse vignette to establish context: a short section of bed, a few recognisable plants, perhaps part of a greenhouse frame. Surrounding space and gaps must be truly transparent, not white or dark haze. NO rectangular scene background, no sky or full greenhouse, no lettering, no border. Complete silhouette with clear padding on every side, no cropped head, elbows, tools or leaf tips. Large high resolution. Photo 1 supplies the real salad bed, hand/colander detail and activity. Photos 2 and 3 show John, the person to draw, including his face and build. Last two images are style references only. Imagine a wider view of this actual salad-picking scene: John kneeling on one knee beside a short low vegetable-bed edge, gently taking ONE outer lettuce leaf with his right hand, holding the metal colander containing a few green/red leaves in his left. Show his face in recognisable three-quarter view, concentrating on the plant. Plain navy T-shirt and open checked shirt as photo 2, practical dark trousers. Natural non-staged working posture. Only 3 loosely growing lettuce plants and a small irregular ground patch; leave the rest truly transparent. Landscape 3:2 with at least 8% transparent margin around ALL content. No greenhouse roof needed. No bouquets or symmetrical arrangements.
